# Trimble Connect ECom Service (accounts, entitlements, activations, licensing)

- **Product:** Trimble Connect ECom Service (accounts, entitlements, activations, licensing) (Trimble Connect family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** Trimble Identity bearer token. Declared security schemes: bearer-key.
- **Access:** Account administrators for account operations; Trimble-internal provisioning for SKU, policy and transaction operations; single-region service.
- **To call it you would need:** a Trimble Identity token with the needed account role; changes to licences, entitlements, activations, SKUs, policies, transactions and invitation keys are excluded.
- **Documented servers:** `https://ecom.connect.trimble.com/v1`.
- **Definition:** [tc-ecom-service](https://ecom.connect.trimble.com/v1/api-docs) (Trimble Connect ECom Service, version 1.9.101). Documentation: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trimble-oss/tc-dotnet-sdk-docs/main/documentation/Developer%20Guide%20-%20EComClient.md.
